title: Recovering in Los Angeles, upcoming Disneyland and Cookery dates, and closing
summary: Back in Los Angeles since December, she faces Disneyland dates and the Cookery on the 16th. She says working makes her feel better, and nobody can tell she was ill. The tape is switched off.
